news.summary: SAN JOSE, Calif., October 21, 2026--Cadence (Nasdaq: CDNS) today announced that Nokia is deploying the Cadence® AuraStack™ AI Super Agent on the Cadence Millennium® M2000 AI Supercomputer to advance electronic system design at scale. By unifying agentic AI, Cadence engineering software and accelerated computing in a secure, on-premises platform, Nokia is accelerating key design and analysis workflows by 5X while maintaining control of sensitive engineering data and intellectual property.
